summary.text: Lisa Freeman is a Republican state representative from Belknap 8 who has represented the district since December 2024 and previously represented Hillsborough 12 from 2016 to 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Freeman graduated from Winthrop Senior High School, attended Laboure College and studied occupational therapy at North Shore Community College, according to Ballotpedia.
During her time on the Manchester Board of School Committee, Ward 5, she lived in Manchester, New Hampshire.
Freeman served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Hillsborough 12 from 2016 to 2018, and at the start of the 2017 session she served on the Election Law Committee.
She assumed office representing Belknap 8 on December 4, 2024.
